value.note: A third-party image under a NonCommercial licence.

why: This edit records the `hall-stone` image as a third-party image under CC BY-NC 4.0, with its licence page, an archived copy and a credit line — every field a third-party record carries. A NonCommercial licence is outside the ADR-0013 allowlist whatever else the record says, and `DW0741` is the allowlist's own code: the same rule a prefab catalog card is judged by. The three fields the primary does not write (an original image has no licence page, archive or credit to record) are written here.
